f.title: Fines EUR 2,000-3,740.98 (natural persons) or up to EUR 44,891.81 (legal persons) for PV breaches
f.statement: Breaches of Art. 29(1)(a)-(n), (2), (4) and (5) and Art. 169-171, of Art. 173, of the MAH duties in Art. 170-B(1)-(2), 173-E(2), 175-G(2) and 175-H(2), conduct of PASS in breach of Art. 175-C, 175-E, 175-F or 175-G, and transmission to the public or HCPs of PV information in a non-objective or misleading way are misdemeanours punishable by a fine of EUR 2,000-3,740.98 or up to EUR 44,891.81, depending on whether the offender is a natural or legal person.

f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness
